select * from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'eds' and table_name like '%MTD_YTD%'	
			
select * from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'eds' and table_name like 'DEPOSIT_FACT'	

select * from om.om_task_run where task_name = 'TSK_CI_DEPOSITS_RETAIL' order by 7 desc

select * from OM.OM_COPY_ACTIVITY_DTL where task_name = 'TSK_CI_DEPOSITS_RETAIL'  order by 6 desc

select * from OM.OM_TASK_ERROR_DTL WHERE task_name = 'TSK_CI_DEPOSITS_RETAIL' 

			YTD_BALANCE_PHP

alter table EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT 
add YTD_BALANCE_PHP numeric(38,10)
			

			
			SELECT 
				 EDF.FORACID	AS	AccountID
				,ECD.ORGKEY	AS	CustomerID
				,NULL	AS	EntityCIF
				,ECD.ORGKEY	AS	FCBSCIF
				,EDA.BANK_ID AS	BankCode
				,EDF.SOL_ID	AS	BranchCode
				,EBD.SOL_DESC	AS	BranchName
				,EBD.AREA	AS	Area
				,EBD.REGION	AS	Region
				,EDA.SOURCE_CODE	AS	Source
				,EDP.PRODUCT_GROUP	AS	ProductGrouping
				,CONCAT(EDP.PRODUCT_GROUP,'-',EDP.PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION)	AS	ProductDetails
				,EDP.PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION	AS	ProductType
				,EDF.ACCT_OPN_DATE	AS	OpenedDate
				,(
					CASE 
					WHEN EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE IN ('M', 'J') 
					THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' 
					END
				)	AS	ShareIndicator 
				,NULL	AS	MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
				,NULL	AS	MonthToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated
				,(
					CASE 
					WHEN EDF.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' 
					THEN ISNULL(EDF.YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP,0) 
					ELSE ISNULL(EDF.YTD_BALANCE_PHP,0) 
					END
				 ) AS YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Full
				,NULL	AS	YearToDateAverageDailyBalance_Prorated
				,EDF.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP	AS	OutstandingBalance_Full
				,NULL	AS	OutstandingBalance_Prorated
				,CAST(EDA.AS_OF_DATE AS DATE) AS	BusinessDate
				,CAST(EDA.AS_OF_DATE AS DATE) AS	LastUpdatedDate
				,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY EDF.FORACID)	AS	AccountKey 
				,EDF.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS AS ACCOUNT_STATUS
			FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA
			LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF
				ON EDA.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID
				AND EDA.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
				AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
			LEFT JOIN EDS.BRANCH_DIM EBD
			    ON EDF.SOL_ID = EBD.SOL_ID
			    AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = EBD.BANK_ID
			    AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN EBD.SCD_START_DATE AND EBD.SCD_END_DATE
			LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
				ON EDA.CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID
				AND EDA.BANK_ID = ECD.BANK_ID
				AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
			LEFT JOIN EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING EDP
			    ON EDF.GAM_SCHM_CODE = EDP.PRODUCT_TYPE
			    AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = EDP.BANK_CODE
			    AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN EDP.SCD_START_DATE AND EDP.SCD_END_DATE

			WHERE 
				EDA.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('2023-09-01' AS DATE) 
				AND EDF.GAM_ACID IS NOT NULL 
				AND EDA.DEL_FLG = 'N'
				AND EDF.DEL_FLG = 'N'
				AND EDF.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
				AND EDA.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
				AND ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
				AND EDF.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C'

				select top 100 * from  EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP a
				join EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT b on a.ACID = b.gam_acid

SELECT DISTINCT CUSTOMER_TYPE,SCD_START_DATE,SCD_END_DATE FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM 

update EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM  set scd_start_date= '2023-09-01'



SELECT 
count(1)
			FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA
			LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF
				ON EDA.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID
				AND EDA.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
				AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
			LEFT JOIN EDS.BRANCH_DIM EBD
			    ON EDF.SOL_ID = EBD.SOL_ID
			    AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = EBD.BANK_ID
			    AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN EBD.SCD_START_DATE AND EBD.SCD_END_DATE
			LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
				ON EDA.CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID
				AND EDA.BANK_ID = ECD.BANK_ID
				AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
			LEFT JOIN EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING EDP
			    ON EDF.GAM_SCHM_CODE = EDP.PRODUCT_TYPE
			    AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = EDP.BANK_CODE
			    AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN EDP.SCD_START_DATE AND EDP.SCD_END_DATE

			WHERE 
				EDA.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('2023-09-01' AS DATE) 
				AND EDF.GAM_ACID IS NOT NULL 
				AND EDA.DEL_FLG = 'N'
				AND EDF.DEL_FLG = 'N'
				AND EDF.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
				AND EDA.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
				AND ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
				AND EDF.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C'

				select top 100 * from  EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP a
				join EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT b on a.ACID = b.gam_acid
